description: Ground-truth calibration bands for the sim matrix. Matchup bands are real-world Modern priors (percent WR for deck_a); field bands are deck-level expected field WRs from the CLAUDE.md post-sim EXPECTED dict. Consumed by tools/check_calibration.py after every --matrix --save. Bands are data with provenance, not code constants.

field_bands.provenance: CLAUDE.md post-sim pipeline EXPECTED dict — Modern's #1 meta share, positive field expectation.

User meta judgment 2026-07-08: Affinity plays as a Tier-1 deck in the July 2026 meta — band raised to the Tier-1 shape (same class as Eldrazi Tron). Supersedes the 'capped by universal SB artifact hate' [45-60] prior; the Bo3 SB-hate cap is real but does not push a Tier-1 deck below the Tier-1 band. The Azorius-vs-Affinity matchup probe is unchanged: 90-10 vs near-even remains a genuine control-interaction divergence at any tier.
